group_scope: independently seeded fixtures on the same wide-config service; X/Y assignments cross on newly started servers. Measure actual credit and every invalid final or late preview.
policy: pre-registered external wait forecasts in milliseconds, no access to actual delay for gating. Require forecast >=350ms and >=1024 observed prompt tokens; at most one speculative request per trust-domain replica instance and no duplicate successful prefetch within a 60s window (256 context revisions max).
decision: report normal and wrong-hint cases separately. An early-return slowdown counts against the policy; single-device evidence cannot qualify a fleet.
